<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/sites/{siteId}/dock-calendar/closures"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Closes one door for `[from, to)`. Closures of one door may not overlap (409 `overlapping-closure`) and a closure may
not cover an active appointment of the door (409 `closure-conflicts-with-appointments`, listing the appointment
ids). Requires an `Idempotency-Key`. Publishes `DoorClosureScheduled`.
